Data & connections

Know what stays local.
Know what connects.

This is an implementation summary for the development version, reviewed on 10 November 2026. It is not a final commercial privacy policy.

On your MacConnectionsThis websitePolicy status

On your Mac

Storage work uses local evidence.

Cairn scans filesystem locations on your Mac and reads file metadata to measure storage and propose candidates. Duplicate comparison can read file contents to compare fingerprints. Access depends on your macOS permissions.

The app stores local settings, dated storage readings, action and recovery records, and transfer records. Those records can include paths, sizes, timestamps and outcomes. Some are kept in Cairn’s Application Support folder; licence records and protected scheduled-rule consent state use the macOS Keychain.

These records can reveal information about your projects and files. Review them before sharing, and do not remove recovery records while an action is unresolved.

Optional connections

Different features have different data flows.

AI-tool connection

When configured, a local tool connection lets a coding client request storage information and plans. Results can include paths and other storage details. The client may then send that information to its own provider under its settings and policies.

Cleaning access is a separate setting. Connecting a tool is not a reason to assume its processing stays on the Mac.

Licence activation

The current implementation contacts Polar at api.polar.sh. Activation sends the licence key, organisation identifier, the Mac’s device label and hardware UUID. Validation and deactivation send the key, organisation and activation identifier.

A saved licence can be validated in the background at launch. Live activation and the final purchase flow are still to be verified. Cairn’s website does not currently collect a payment.

Rule updates

The source includes requests for a signed rules list and its signature at cairnmac.com. Rule updates are currently disabled because no verification key is configured. If enabled in a future release, the host will receive ordinary network-request information.

Problem reports

The app can prepare a report containing version, hardware, permissions, scan and cleanup summaries, plus limited crash details. It is shown for inspection and copying. A support email address is not configured.

Do not assume a generated report or screenshot is suitable to share without reading it. You choose the recipient and what to include.

This website

Fonts, hosting and outgoing links.

The current pages request Inter font files from Google Fonts through fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com. Those requests share ordinary connection information, including your IP address and browser request metadata, with the font service.

The active website contains no analytics script, signup form or checkout form. That is a statement about this source version, not a promise about the logs or infrastructure of its hosting provider.

Following an external link connects to the destination service under its own policies. Public deployment has not been verified. Hosting data handling and the final public hosting arrangement still need to be reviewed before public release.

Before public release

The final policy is still needed.

The operator’s legal identity and contact details, applicable rights, retention arrangements and any final service-provider disclosures have not been approved for this website. This page does not invent those details.

Before sales or public distribution, the final policy needs to match the shipped app, live payment flow and hosting configuration.
